top_choice_rationale: P006 recognizes a mature, foundational, and unusually sharply attributable sequence of dynamic-panel estimators. Arellano, Blundell, and Bond map directly to the linked difference-GMM and system-GMM advances, which made persistent dynamic panels with individual effects and endogenous regressors empirically tractable. Weak-instrument, instrument-proliferation, and specification concerns substantially qualify particular applications but do not erase the underlying econometric contribution.
